status: isolated engine-only local reproduction; not a replacement for the original U13 gate
sourceFinding: The exact released patch 0030 write() constructs the entire memos() JSON before comparing cache version counters. Adopting kept entries increments neither counter; with no file work all counters remain zero, every 30-second cycle constructs and discards an unchanged snapshot without a written log.
fixRecommendation: In the engine, cheaply compare cache change counters before constructing memo snapshots; preserve the snapshot counters for publication and detect concurrent stores on a later cycle. Add a warm-adopted, unchanged-version regression that observes no snapshot construction across timer cycles. A server pending/publication heuristic cannot fix this unmodified-snapshot allocation.
